name: answer-not-json
why: A text block that is not JSON at all — structured output constrains the response, and this is what it looks like when that constraint does not hold.

provenance.why_not_recorded: The API cannot be asked to return something its own `output_config.format` forbids, so this body is constructed to prove the parser reports a schema failure rather than raising a `JSONDecodeError` out of a paid call.
